kindling.title: KINDLING — The Story of Melina
kindling.description: Melina tells the whole journey as a single cinematic story: Torrent's choice, the accord, the road to Leyndell, the freedom she found there, and the fire she chose for herself.

ranni.title: THE WHOLE DARK MOON — The Testament of Ranni
ranni.description: Ranni tells the history others wrote around her: the leash of the Two Fingers, the Night of Black Knives, the flesh she slew, the faithful who paid, and the thousand-year voyage beyond the Order's reach.
